title: Workflow Body Sections
description: Markdown body sections expected in every workflow file. Not frontmatter.

## Steps.description: Numbered step-by-step procedure. Each step has a goal, optional code block, and a checkpoint. Append new steps; preserve existing steps.

## From sources.description: One entry per source wikilink that informed this workflow, describing what it contributed. Append new entries; never duplicate.

## Notes.description: Free-form overflow notes that don't fit a first-class section. Append paragraphs; preserve existing text.
